x-pmi-mapping: Decision log: a widely used project-management practice, not an artifact named in the PMBOK Guide, Eighth Edition (see ADR-0007).
title: Decision log entry
description: One decision the group actually made, including a decision to reject an option. Proposals and open questions without an outcome are not decisions. Use only information stated or clearly implied in the artifact; omit any optional field that is not.

title.description: Short label for the decision, about ten words or fewer.

statement.description: What was decided, as one plain sentence. A decision not to do something is valid, for example: Do not use supplier B for the pilot.

context.description: The question or problem the decision answers.

rationale.description: Why this option was chosen, as stated in the artifact.

alternatives.description: Options that were considered and not chosen.

decided_by.description: People, roles or groups who made the decision, as named in the artifact.

decided_on.description: Date the decision was made, only if the artifact states it. Never use today's date.

impacts.description: What changes as a result, for example work, scope, cost, schedule or other decisions affected.
